text: On the right side of Ironvale Athletic’s half, Jonah Lindqvist carries the ball forward. He quickly plays a short pass to Ilias Thorne, positioned centrally about 9 metres from the Redmond Rovers’ goal at the far end. Thorne controls the ball and shoots with his foot, scoring to equalize the score at 3-3 in the 86th minute. This goal comes from a swift counter-attack exploiting space behind Redmond’s high defensive line. [#1532] [#1533] [#1534] [#1535] [#1537]
